title: Inventory the playback boundary
objective: Document callers of the legacy playback services and introduce only the contract tests needed for the future PlaybackController boundary.
acceptance: All playback service callers and manifest entries are identified with evidence.
Contract tests describe the single PlaybackController boundary without activating a second player path.
The affected listener variants build successfully.
rollback: Revert the contract-test change; no runtime cutover or production state is modified.
